name: 04-helpdesk-repeated-instructions
description: Helpdesk chat where the client appends the rules to every user message (dedupe: paragraphs).

messages.content:
You are the internal IT helpdesk assistant of a mid-size manufacturing company.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.

My SAP GUI shows "logon balancing error". What can I do?

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Restart SAP Logon and select the system again. If the error continues, the message server may be down; please open a ticket.

How do I reset my SAP password?

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Use the self-service password reset link on the logon screen. You will receive a confirmation email.

Outlook does not sync my calendar.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Close Outlook, start it again and check the connection status in the bottom bar. If it shows "Disconnected", open a ticket.

The printer on floor 2 prints empty pages.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Please check the toner level on the printer display. If the toner is fine, open a ticket so facility IT can check the device.

VPN disconnects every 10 minutes.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Update the VPN client from the software center and switch to the "Corporate-EU" profile.

Can I install Python on my laptop?

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Yes, Python is available in the software center. Administrator rights are not needed.

My Fiori launchpad tile for "Manage Purchase Orders" disappeared.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Your role assignment may have changed. Please open a ticket and mention the tile name.

Teams camera is black.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
Check the privacy shutter on the laptop and the camera permission in Windows settings.

Excel crashes when I open the monthly controlling report.

Rules for your answer:
- Answer in the language of the question.
- Never ask for passwords or one-time codes.
- If the issue needs an administrator, tell the user to open a ticket in the IT service portal.
